assessment: Monstera deliciosa is showing signs of chronic underwatering: dry, crispy brown leaf tips and edges, curling leaves, and lighter-than-normal coloring. The soil has pulled away from the pot edges indicating severe dehydration.

actions.action: Give the plant a thorough bottom-watering by placing the pot in a basin of room-temperature water for 20–30 minutes until soil is fully rehydrated.
actions.label: Deep soak

actions.action: Mist the leaves daily for the next week to increase local humidity and reduce transpiration stress while roots recover.
actions.label: Mist leaves

actions.action: Set a watering reminder for every 7–10 days. Check soil moisture before watering — the top inch should be dry but soil below should still feel slightly moist.
actions.label: Set schedule
